SMTO-RST-0027 — SMTO's saved data files don't agree with each other

GUID: ef481323-bd03-5566-86cd-b69840adebf7
Slug: controller-recovery-identity-ambiguous
Domain: RST · Subsystem: controller

What happened

  • SMTO stopped while starting because its saved files disagree about which save is the latest. It didn't guess, and it didn't change any of them.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Don't delete, move or replace files in SMTO's data folder. The repair needs the current files to work out which ones belong together.
  2. If you recently restored or copied the data folder by hand, note where that copy came from. Files from different saves can't be matched safely, so knowing their source helps put back one complete set.
  3. Open Technical details and select Copy error details. The message names the file that didn't match.

What success looks like

  • After the repair, the startup screen reaches Ready and your latest conversations appear.

If it still fails

  • Send the copied details and your note to the person who manages SMTO. Don't switch to an older save yourself; that would lose recent work. Don't delete the data folder.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The commit manifest, domain inventory or recovery-bundle revision does not identify one complete, matching checkpoint, so startup recovery refused to select a revision.

What this means

  • The commit manifest, domain inventory or JSON revision does not identify one complete matching checkpoint. Automatic recovery never rolls back or replays operations.

Why this can happen

  • Commit identities, ordered delta revisions or required domain inventories disagree.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect Server storage diagnostics and retained manifests without changing committed data.

How to fix it

  • With the Server stopped, inspect checkpoints/manifest.json, the selected generation's domain inventory and its recovery manifest (python -m agent_runtime.runtime_state.operator inspect on the state root). Restore one verified, complete generation whose commit, inventory and revision agree before restarting; do not select an older revision automatically.
  • Preserve all retained generations and inspect the commit and bundle manifests offline. Restore a verified complete identity before restarting; do not select an older revision automatically.

Retry and execution caution

  • A complete supported representation of the selected revision is available.

How to verify the fix

  • The Server validates the paired representations and reaches READY at the selected revision.

What not to do

  • Do not delete evidence, automatically roll back or replay commands.

Technical notes

  • Recovery uses the same committed epoch and revision. No model call participates.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.

Do not confuse with / related errors

  • SMTO-RST-0017 — SMTO couldn't open your saved data safely
